problem_statement: When a MAC frame carries the sequence-suppression flag in its frame control field but is not an 802.15.4-2015 frame, the stack incorrectly treats the frame as having no sequence number. Sequence suppression is only defined for 2015 frames, so a 2003 or 2006 frame that has that bit set still contains a sequence number and should be reported as having one. This misreporting also affects the computed address/header field sizes and the sequence index for such frames. The behavior should be that the presence of a sequence number depends on the frame version: only 2015 frames honor the suppression bit.
